tasks.label: Run development server
args: $ports = @(8788, 8790); foreach ($port in $ports) { $connections = netstat -ano -p tcp | Select-String "LISTENING\s+$port"; if ($connections) { $pid = ($connections -split '\s+')[-1]; if ($pid -match '^\d+$') { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; npm run div
